bullets.text: Elara raises Amber TP to Rs9,040 (BUY) but cuts electronics margin target 50-100bps; Q2 EBITDA margin 3.7%, Sidwal guide cut to 15-20%.
bullets.source: Elara - Amber Enterprises - Robust sales growth; margin under heat - Q2FY27 Update - Buy - TP: INR 9,040

detail.summary: Q2 sales beat on electronics and a weak RAC base, but price-hike lags in RACs and fixed-price railway contracts crushed margins. Elara keeps BUY on the mobile venture and PCB capex, rolling forward at a lower multiple; FY28E/FY29E EPS trimmed for margin pressure.
points: Q2 sales Rs26.3bn, +60% YoY, 37% above Elara est
TP Rs8,730 -> Rs9,040 on 42x (from 45x) Sep FY28E

bullets.text: BNPP puts Dixon on its five-name India long list after the rally from 26-Oct lows.
bullets.source: BNP Paribas - BNPP India Reflexions: Uncoiling Spring

bullets.text: I-Sec upgrades NMDC to BUY (TP Rs91 from 95); Q2 EBITDA Rs19.4bn 6% below est on monsoon-hit Chhattisgarh dispatch, H2 rebound expected.
bullets.source: ICICI Securities - NMDC (BUY): Monsoon-related disruptions impact dispatches; expect sharp rebound in H2

detail.summary: A damaged railway line cut Chhattisgarh dispatch for about a month, so higher realisations were offset by volume. I-Sec expects the new 15mtpa Bacheli-Nagarnar slurry pipeline and rail doubling to recover most of H1's sales miss in H2, and builds 7% volume CAGR to 60mtpa by FY29E.
points: EBITDA/t Rs1,851; royalty +30% YoY to Rs28.3bn
Rs3.4bn favourable inventory adjustment in EBITDA

bullets.text: Nagarro tracking the low end of CY26 guide (9M +2.7% cc, 14.2% margin); Persistent holds ~94%, completion awaits regulatory approval.
bullets.source: IIFL - Persistent Systems [PSYS IN, BUY]: Takeaways from Nagarro's 3QCY26 results

detail.summary: Nagarro's quarter was soft, with the US and Germany both down and demand described as challenging. Guidance was reiterated, but 9M run-rates sit at its lower end on growth and margin, so the integration upside Persistent is paying for is the thing to watch.
points: 3Q +0.6% cc QoQ, -0.2% cc YoY; organic -1.6% YoY
EUR350mn RCF (EUR275mn drawn) restructuring by end-Dec

bullets.text: BNPP lists Wipro among five India shorts; IT the rally's laggard, Nifty IT -1% since 26-Oct against Nifty +11%.
bullets.source: BNP Paribas - BNPP India Reflexions: Uncoiling Spring

bullets.text: BNPP: FPIs +$8bn in November after $30bn YTD outflows; Nifty +11% from 26-Oct lows on oil -17% and a stable INR.
bullets.source: BNP Paribas - BNPP India Reflexions: Uncoiling Spring

detail.summary: BNPP says the late-October rotation into defensives has broadened into top-100 rate-sensitives (financials, autos, realty). The two triggers are a US mid-term result that raised AI-regulation fears, making India an anti-AI trade, and falling oil with RBI holding the rupee. It urges discernment from here because both can reverse.
points: FPI +$8bn Nov vs -$30bn YTD to Oct
Longs: CGPOWER, DIXON, BJFIN, KFINTECH, TTAN
Shorts: INDUSTOW, CIPLA, WPRO, ZYDUSLIF, SWIGGY

bullets.text: MS: India petcoke consumption -11% YoY in October as coal undercuts it on freight; diesel +12%, bitumen +17% on post-monsoon construction.
bullets.source: Morgan Stanley - PULSE: India Energy: Tracking Demand

detail.summary: October fuel demand rose 2% YoY to ~5.4mbpd on transport fuels while industrial and household use fell. MS stays constructive on refiners and estimates a ~US$90/bbl Brent breakeven for retailers' normal margins.
points: LPG -12% YoY on Gulf supply disruption

ai_semis.text: BNPP: a Democrat US mid-term win raised fears of AI regulation and datacenter limits; Nasdaq 100 -5% since 26-Oct.
ai_semis.source: BNP Paribas - BNPP India Reflexions: Uncoiling Spring
